projection.label: MODEL, fitted to measured constants; not a measurement
projection.model: rho(n') = S_top*sqrt(2^(3n')/h); DS_rel(n') = kappa*2^n'*(alpha + beta*n'); LA_fit = 2^la0 * F^gamma (OLS on rungs with F >= 256); LA_c2 = c2*F^2 (c2 = mean LA/F^2 of the top three rungs); F = fb_ratio*2^n'; balanced base F/lambda: relation phase x lambda^2, LA x lambda^-2, lambda = max(1, (LA_c2/DS_rel)^(1/4))
